sentences.en: Our daughter is none the better because we've been nursing.
sentences.zh: 我们的女儿因为我们在照料她而并没有好转。

sentences.en: Mennad taught Baya everything she needed to know about nursing.
sentences.zh: 梅纳德教会了贝亚护理所需的一切知识。

sentences.en: Mennad was speaking to his new nurses and nursing students.
sentences.zh: 梅纳德正在和他的新护士和护理学生说话。
